pairs: Verbum Domini, quod factum est ad Joël,
The word of the Lord that came to Joel,
si factum est istud in diebus vestris,
Did this ever happen in your days
or in the days of your fathers?
Talk this over with your sons,
and your sons with their sons,
and their sons with another generation.
The locust has eaten what the caterpillar has left,
and the beetle has eaten what the locust has left,
and the mildew has eaten what the beetle has left.
omnes qui bibitis vinum in dulcedine,
all you who delight in drinking wine;
for it has been cut off from your mouth.
Gens enim ascendit super terram meam,
For a nation has ascended over my land:
His teeth are like the teeth of a lion,
et molares ejus ut catuli leonis.
and his molars are like that of a lion’s young.
He has put my vineyard into desolation,
and he has pulled off the bark of my fig tree.
Plange quasi virgo accincta sacco super virum pubertatis suæ.
Lament like a betrothed virgin, wrapped in sackcloth at the loss of the husband of her youth.
Periit sacrificium et libatio de domo Domini;
and libation have perished from the house of the Lord;
the priests who are ministers of the Lord have mourned.
For the wheat has been devastated,
ululaverunt vinitores super frumento et hordeo,
the vineyard workers have wailed over the crop and the barley,
because the harvest of the field has perished.
and the fig tree has languished.
and all the trees of the field have withered.
quia confusum est gaudium a filiis hominum.
For joy has been thrown into disorder before the sons of men.
quoniam interiit de domo Dei vestri sacrificium et libatio.
For sacrifice and libation have passed away from the house of your God.
omnes habitatores terræ in domum Dei vestri,
and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of your God.
And cry out to the Lord:
For the day of the Lord is near,
et quasi vastitas a potente veniet.
and it will arrive, like a devastation, before the powerful.
Numquid non coram oculis vestris alimenta perierunt de domo Dei nostri,
Has not your nourishment perished from before your eyes,
joy and gladness from the house of our God?
The mules have rotted in their own manure,
the wine cellars have been destroyed,
because the grain has been ruined.
because there is no pasture for them.
and even the flocks of sheep have been lost.
because fire has devoured the beauty of the wilderness,
et flamma succendit omnia ligna regionis.
and the flame has burned all the trees of the countryside.
and even the beasts of the field have gazed up at you,
like the dry ground thirsting for rain,
because the fountains of waters have dried up,
and fire has devoured the beauty of the wilderness.
